items.title: Concurrency applied to a web game
items.summary: A web game with local PvP and Zombie modes. Movement, pursuit and timing are distributed across Web Workers so Phaser's main loop stays focused on rendering and collisions.
highlights: Independent workers process both players' controls, zombie pursuit and the timer.
State travels through postMessage while Phaser keeps rendering and collisions on the main thread.
Includes PvP with WASD and arrow keys plus a 60-second Zombie survival mode.

items.title: Auditable RAG for Mexican workplace regulations
items.summary: An assistant covering four Mexican workplace health and safety standards. It retrieves regulatory evidence, answers with exact clauses and stores traces so every response can be audited.
highlights: A state-machine parser turns inconsistent DOF document formats into 248 citable chunks with regulatory metadata.
Retrieval uses multilingual-e5-small embeddings and ChromaDB; answers enforce citation, abstention and follow-up rewriting contracts.
An evaluation harness checks retrieval, citation accuracy, abstention, multi-turn answers and groundedness; every query stores evidence, scores and an audit trace.
